capabilities: Sync Karakeep bookmarks into Markdown notes on a configurable interval
Save bookmark images and assets to an attachments folder
Sync notes and highlights back to Karakeep
Handle deleted and archived bookmarks with delete, archive-folder, or tag actions
Customize note rendering with Eta templates
extras: The plugin is still labeled "Hoarder Sync" in settings despite the Karakeep name; users must configure CORS (e.g. a Traefik middleware) to allow requests from Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull bookmarks saved in Karakeep into the vault as notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin syncs your Karakeep bookmarks with Obsidian, creating markdown notes for each bookmark

summary: Syncs Karakeep bookmarks into a vault folder as Markdown notes with metadata, assets, highlights, and configurable deletion handling.
